WITH cust_agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_order_count,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase_ts
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  ca.customer_unique_id,
  (
    SELECT o2.customer_id
    FROM orders o2
    JOIN customers c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id
    WHERE c2.customer_unique_id = ca.customer_unique_id
      AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp = ca.latest_purchase_ts
    ORDER BY o2.order_purchase_timestamp DESC, o2.order_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS representative_customer_id,
  ca.total_order_count,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_order_count DESC) AS rank
FROM cust_agg ca
ORDER BY ca.total_order_count DESC
LIMIT 3;
